Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rule 214(a)(2) of the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure, 18 C.F.R. § 385.214(a)(2), the Arkansas Public Service Commission (Arkansas Commission or APSC) hereby provides notice of intervention in this Docket.
The Arkansas Commission is the state regulatory agency, pursuant to Ark. Code Ann. § 23-2-101 et seq. The Commission has general regulatory authority over electric and natural gas public utilities and certain water and sewer public utilities providing retail utility services to the public for compensation.  The Commission is charged with the duty of ensuring that public utilities provide safe, adequate, and reliable utility service at just and reasonable rates.
The retail rates and services of utilities regulated by the APSC may be affected by the decision in this proceeding and as such, the APSC has substantial, direct interests that may be affected by the outcome of this proceeding.  Pursuant to FERC Rule 214(a)(2), 18 C.F.R. § 385.214(a)(2), the Arkansas Commission is entitled to intervene as a matter of right pursuant to timely filing of notice.
The APSC respectfully requests waiver of Rule 203(b) of the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure, 18 C.F.R. § 385.203(b), to the extent necessary to allow its representatives below, submitted with this doc-less intervention, to be included on the official service list for this proceeding:
